summary: Verified the two reported bug fixes end-to-end (backend pytest + real browser via Playwright on the preview URL). All 5 focused acceptance criteria PASS. 7/7 backend tests pass; 3/3 UI flows pass with no page errors.

evidence.1_profile_route: POST /api/auth/login 200 with aarohi@cleliastudio-demo.com; navigated to /profile; [data-testid=profile-page] visible; h1='Your profile'; profile-name-input, profile-email-input, save-profile-button all visible; 0 pageerrors and 0 console errors. Route now registered in /app/frontend/src/App.js line 20.
evidence.2_design_confirm_creates_design: Walked steps 1->6 via UI (Ring -> example idea 1 -> 18K Yellow Gold -> Create -> guidance streamed -> Confirm). Observed POST https://.../api/designs => status 200; localStorage.clelia-last-design-id set to 'e9d7d156-a3f7-45e5-b44d-942fd31d742b'; inline confirmation 'Your design has been saved to your Design Vault.' rendered. Pytest test_create_design_and_persistence additionally POSTs then GETs /api/designs and confirms the new design_id is present with correct customer_id, jewellery_type, prompt and specs.metal.
evidence.3_signed_out_confirm_error: After removing clelia-customer-token from localStorage on step 6 and clicking Confirm, [data-testid=designer-error-message] showed 'Please sign in or create an account before saving your design.' (screenshot attached). No silent failure.
evidence.4_customer_forbidden_staff_endpoints: test_customer_cannot_access_staff_orders: GET /api/staff/orders with customer bearer => 403. test_customer_cannot_access_print_file: GET /api/staff/orders/<id>/print-file with customer bearer => 403.
evidence.5_pytest_run: 7 passed in 2.34s (test_health, test_customer_login_ok, test_content_endpoint, test_create_design_and_persistence, test_designs_requires_auth [401], test_customer_cannot_access_staff_orders [403], test_customer_cannot_access_print_file [403]).

critical_code_review_comments: DesignStudioPage.jsx moveForward(): after step 6 save it reads search.get('return_url') from the initial URL and unconditionally window.location.assign(returnUrl) - this happens even on save failure (setError is called but the redirect still fires). Consider early-return on error so the user can read the inline error.

DesignStudioPage.jsx uses the .inline-error class (data-testid='designer-error-message') for BOTH errors and the success confirmation ('Your design has been saved...'). Using an error-styled element for a success message is misleading - use a distinct success/toast state.

SupportingPages.jsx ProfilePage is a static form: profile-name-input and profile-email-input have no value/onChange/prefill from /api/auth/me and the Save button is not wired to any PATCH endpoint. The route now renders but the form does nothing - main agent should decide whether this is acceptable for the current scope (route/render-only fix) or needs follow-up.

server.py CORS: allow_methods is ['GET','POST','PATCH'] but the app also exposes DELETE-like semantics could be needed later; PUT is used by /api/manager/content - PUT is currently NOT in allow_methods, which will break preflight for the manager content update from the browser.
SupportingPages.jsx LoginPage: signup name input is not controlled and not sent - name field ignored, hard-coded 'Clelia Customer' posted.
seed_data_creation: Backend test_create_design_and_persistence added 1 design (prompt prefixed 'TEST_iter8') for the sample customer. UI walkthrough added 1 additional design. Not cleaned up (no DELETE endpoint exposed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The two originally reported bugs are FIXED and verified live on https://luxe-maker-sandbox.preview.emergentagent.com. /profile now renders (route added in App.js). POST /api/designs is invoked from DesignStudioPage step-6 Confirm and returns 200; last-design-id is stored in localStorage. Signed-out confirm shows an inline sign-in error rather than silently failing. Customer JWT is correctly rejected (403) on /api/staff/orders and /api/staff/orders/{id}/print-file. Out-of-scope items (Razorpay checkout, Google OAuth, phone OTP, password reset, email verify, AR device, 3D asset generation) were not tested per the review request. See critical_code_review_comments for follow-ups that were observed but not blocking: (a) ProfilePage form is not wired to backend, (b) inline-error component is reused as a success confirmation, (c) unconditional return_url redirect even on save failure, (d) CORS allow_methods missing PUT for manager content, (e) signup name field is not controlled.
rca_of_the_issue: Original bug 1 (/profile 404): App.js Routes had no path='/profile' entry. Added <Route path='/profile' element={<ProfilePage />} /> and imported ProfilePage from SupportingPages. Verified: 200 render with profile-page testid. Original bug 2 (Confirm did not create design): DesignStudioPage.moveForward only advanced steps and streamed guidance; the step-6 branch never called POST /api/designs. Added authenticated fetch to /api/designs with token from localStorage.clelia-customer-token, storing returned id in clelia-last-design-id. Unauthenticated path now sets an inline sign-in error. Verified live: server returns 200 and design is persisted (GET /api/designs contains the new id under the customer).
